lesson: Zeta enters the rank-2 apex kernel only as the base (u+1)/(u-1) times the Blaschke insertion of its own symmetric zero set. Without the pole the form is an antisymmetrised product of Bezoutians and is positive for every insertion. With the pole, the whole reflection law sits in the cross terms from the single negative square of the Bezoutian. The c17 parity clause does not hold in the model in its stated form.
